description: This file contains Python code defining functions and classes for parsing and applying .gitignore style path filters, including pattern translation, line parsing, and filter application logic.

classes.name: PathFilter
classes.description: A class that reads ignore rules from .gitignore and additional patterns, and determines if a given path should be included or ignored based on these rules.

methods.name: fnmatch_translate
methods.description: Translates a shell pattern into a compiled regular expression for matching file paths.

methods.name: parse_line
methods.description: Parses a line from a .gitignore file or pattern list into a tuple indicating inversion, directory-only, and the compiled regex pattern.
